radial_form_contract.all_levels: one permanent inverse-distance stretch family from ZAFF0 onward

radial_form_contract.ZAFF1_to_ZAFF3: update r0 and p and add asymptotically vanishing inverse-distance corrections and couplings without replacing the base function
radial_form_contract.legacy: old serialized Morse fields remain readable but are not emitted by the v6 compiler

preferred.backend: any validated QM code through APOC

empirical_fallback.atomic_synthons: constructed from the same complete empirical state

radial_contract.selection_rule: same Hamiltonian and declared error tolerance on analytic and lookup paths

levels.geometry: rigid bonds and angles; acyclic torsions and intermolecular rigid-body coordinates remain active
active_terms: primitive bonded stretches and bends
intrinsic CM5 Gaussian electrostatics
isotropic synthon-pair Exp-PE
directional H-bond Exp-PE
directional X-bond Exp-PE
synthon-typed GFN-FF-derived Fourier torsions
validated primitive ring terms
optional declared reaction field and confinement
levels.parameter_owner: resident ZAFF libraries compiled by ARCHITECT
population_routes: complete CM5 charges and Mayer bond orders for the full system

parameter_sources.stretches: MM3 atom-type Morse library with synthon interpolation, translated once to the permanent generalized inverse-power form
parameter_sources.angles_and_other_valence: resident GAFF/GAFF2 atom-type library with synthon interpolation
parameter_sources.torsions: GFN-FF-analogous synthon rules in periodic ZAFF form
parameter_sources.electrostatics: all-pair Gaussian charges from the selected ORACLE population route

levels.geometry: reference geometry plus total or declared partial Hessian information
active_terms: all ZAFF0 transferable and nonbonded terms
Pareto-selected diagonal primitive field constrained by the available Hessian information
generalized inverse-power stretches with De fixed from the ZAFF library
all dissociating couplings between X-H stretches sharing one heavy atom
levels.selection: Pareto accuracy, locality, sparsity and symmetry; ZAFF0 priors remain in unconstrained directions of a partial Hessian

levels.geometry: complete QM harmonic field retained in native asymptotically correct ZAFF forms
active_terms: all ZAFF1 terms
the same generalized inverse-power stretches constrained by the complete QM Hessian and fixed library De asymptotes
all harmonic couplings in native switched ZAFF form
certified pruning of spectroscopically irrelevant couplings only

levels.geometry: complete anharmonic field in native asymptotically correct ZAFF forms
active_terms: all ZAFF2 terms
complete diagonal and off-diagonal anharmonic field supported by the acquired derivative order
periodic Fourier LAM valleys and switched LAM-SAM couplings
all additional native ZAFF terms required by independent anharmonic certification
levels.reduction_policy: fit the complete acquired anharmonic field first; any subsequent pruning is a separately certified compression and does not define ZAFF3
required_qm_derivatives: displaced Hessians, gradients or equivalent anharmonic training data
